verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets users write routing conditions that automatically apply context edits whenever a matching situation arises mid-conversation, with no redeploy. Those edits include appending guidance, editing tool descriptions, tightening input schemas, or rewriting tool results. Conditions can be previewed against stored traces before activation, so this is a real first-party rule-to-action mechanism, but the only possible actions are context edits on the agent's conversation, not general event-driven automation. Missing for 10: actions beyond context injection (e.g. notifications, external calls, workflow steps), a documented event catalog or trigger types, detail on the rule/condition syntax, independent hands-on corroboration.
